g.text: An end-to-end single-cell RNA-seq annotation platform
Electron + React desktop UI • FastAPI backend • Python scientific core
seven independent backends run in parallel on the same clustering
dashed violet outline = LLM-touching (shares provider layer with the AI assistant)
UMAP / MDE canvas with lasso selection, on-the-fly differential
expression, live recoloring, and versioned annotation layers.
Lasso a region or pick a cluster → re-cluster → re-annotate → merge
refined labels back into the parent AnnData (nested supported).
300 DPI exports (PNG / SVG / PDF / JPEG) preserve full vector fidelity.
In-app chat sidebar with a pluggable provider layer
(OpenAI • Anthropic) configured through the Settings panel.
Interprets QC, marker genes, heterogeneity; reasons over the
per-method confidence and the consensus call to suggest labels.
the same provider abstraction backs mLLMCelltype upstream
Blind-analysis mode hides labels for unbiased review.
volcano, dot, QC violins (PNG / SVG / PDF / JPEG)
violet outline = shared LLM provider layer (mLLMCelltype + AI assistant)
